name: Zeus
hook: The thunderbolt-wielding king of the Greek gods, and the family tree Jeopardy keeps climbing.

facts.label: Cronus and Rhea
facts.statement: Zeus was the son of the Titans Cronus and Rhea. Rhea saved him by giving Cronus a stone to swallow, and Zeus later forced his father to disgorge his siblings.

facts.label: the Titans
facts.statement: Zeus led the Olympians in overthrowing the Titans, the earlier generation of gods, and banished them to Tartarus.

facts.label: Hera
facts.statement: Hera is Zeus's sister and wife and the goddess of marriage. He once hung her by the wrists from Mount Olympus, and Aphrodite lent her a magic girdle.

facts.label: Athena
facts.statement: Zeus swallowed his first wife Metis, and Athena was then born full-grown from his head, fully armed.

facts.label: Heracles
facts.statement: Zeus assumed Amphitryon's form to seduce Alcmene, and their son was the demigod Heracles, known to the Romans as Hercules.

facts.label: the swan
facts.statement: Zeus came to Leda disguised as a swan; the encounter led to the birth of Helen of Troy and the twins Castor and Pollux.

facts.label: Statue of Zeus at Olympia
facts.statement: Phidias made the giant Statue of Zeus at Olympia, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World; he also made the Athena Parthenos.
